Button group visual regression

Use Tab / Shift+Tab, open dropdowns, and press buttons. Focus rings and arrows must remain visible.

C1 — Buttons only
C2 — Select → icon button
C3 — Button → select
C4 — Icons around select
C5 — Select → button → select
C6 — Adjacent selects / size=1
C7 — Disabled controls
C8 — Tall button
C9 — Standalone comparison
C10 — Excluded listboxes
